subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Yoga: Meditation and Breathing'.
 
• The most appropriate preposition for the given blank is '**to**'.
 
• The phrase **'care to'** means 'looking after somebody/something so that he/she/it has what he/she/it needs for his/her/its health and protection'. (किसी की देखभाल या देखरेख)
 
 
• *Example: Would you **care to** expand on that a bit?*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *If you thought that yoga was all about bending and twisting your body in odd shapes, it’s time to rethink. Yoga is much more. In very simple words, giving care **to** your body, mind and breath is yoga. Derived (3) ______ the Sankrit word ‘yuj’ which means ‘to unite or integrate’, yoga is (4) ______ 5,000-year-old Indian body of knowledge. Yoga is all about harmonising the body (5) ______ the mind and breath through means of various breathing exercises, yoga poses (asanas) and meditation.*

181:T981,

The correct answer
